sections: 9.3.2 character spacing and 9.3.3 single-byte code32 word spacing
9.4.2 text positioning; 9.4.3 quote/TJ operators and thousandth-text-unit signed displacement

decisions: Match source-order semantic Unicode without inventing separators or per-scalar ligature geometry
Require finite at-most-250ms regex calls and shared operation cancellation/deadline checkpoints
Remove exact complete source codes and compensate glyph plus spacing advances through signed TJ values
Keep unrelated source operators/ActualText and explicit source position; foreground black replacement is an explicit bounded profile
Reject unsupported target ActualText, tags, Forms and reflow rather than claiming accessibility/owner preservation
Retain historical/unreachable bytes and distinguish content editing from secure redaction
